body:
The first approach has worked quite well.

I've gone about implementing it by listening for the helper `result` event and then using `setQuery` to  change the query for the other instances. I've used the stats widget to output the count for each instance. Obviously it triggers a lot of queries/renders though so not sure how performant it will be.

The only outstanding issue is that the searchbox is not updating when the query changes. Is there a way to trigger a re-render or manually set it?
